scope: Spider dev 集 20 个数据库，每库采样 5 题（共 99 题）；真实 Spider SQLite 数据库；LLM 直出 SQL（无语义层）
metric_policy: EX 严格判等（结果集完全一致才计正确）；Jaccard>=0.8 记为 partial_match 参考指标，不计入 EX

results.question: What is maximum and minimum death toll caused each time?
results.gold_sql: SELECT max(killed) ,  min(killed) FROM death
results.agent_sql:
SELECT 
  ship.lost_in_battle,
  battle.name,
  MAX(death.killed) as max_death_toll,
  MIN(death.killed) as min_death_toll
FROM death
JOIN ship ON death.caused_by_ship_id = ship.id
JOIN battle ON ship.lost_in_battle = battle.id
GROUP BY ship.lost_in_battle, battle.name
ORDER BY ship.lost_in_battle

results.question: How many car models are produced in the usa?
results.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.Maker  =  T2.Id JOIN COUNTRIES AS T3 ON T2.Country  =  T3.CountryId WHERE T3.CountryName  =  'usa';
results.agent_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ml.ModelId)
FROM model_list ml
JOIN car_makers cm ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
JOIN countries c ON cm.Country = c.CountryId
WHERE c.CountryName = 'usa'

results.question: What are the different models for the cards produced after 1980?
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.model FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.model  =  T2.model JOIN CARS_DATA AS T3 ON T2.MakeId  =  T3.id WHERE T3.year  >  1980;
results.agent_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ml.Model
FROM model_list ml
JOIN car_names cn ON ml.Model = cn.Model
JOIN cars_data cd ON cn.MakeId = cd.Id
WHERE cd.Year > 1980

results.question: What is the name of the different car makers who produced a car in 1970?

results.agent_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT cm.Maker
FROM car_makers cm
JOIN model_list ml ON cm.Id = ml.Maker
JOIN car_names cn ON ml.Model = cn.Model
JOIN cars_data cd ON cn.MakeId = cd.Id
WHERE cd.Year = 1970

results.question: What is the most populace city that speaks English?

results.agent_sql:

FROM city c

results.question: What is the first name, country code, and birth date of the player with the most winner rank points across all matches?

results.question: Find the average ranking for each player and their first name.
results.gold_sql: SELECT avg(ranking) ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.first_name
results.agent_sql:
SELECT p.first_name, AVG(r.ranking) as average_ranking
FROM players p

ORDER BY p.first_name
